# NiriManager

> **File:** `services/compositor/NiriManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

CompositorManager's backend on niri (docs/dev/compositor/contract.md, docs/dev/compositor/niri-backend.md): niri's state as the compositor-neutral shapes (NiriState), and the primitives CompositorManager builds on. The state comes from niri's event stream, kept up event by event (NiriState.reduce); the outputs, which the stream doesn't hold, from an Outputs request whenever the workspaces or screens change.

### Properties

- `windows` (readonly var): The windows (NiriState.windows)
- `outputs` (readonly var): The enabled outputs (NiriState.outputs)
- `workspaces` (readonly var): The workspaces with an id of axiom's (NiriState.workspaces): each output's first `blockSize`
- `focusedOutput` (readonly string): The focused output's name, or ""
- `activeWindowId` (readonly string): The focused window's id, or ""
- `gapsOut` (readonly var): niri's gap at the screen edges: its gaps plus its struts, as the config it runs sets them (axiom's module in it)
- `splitWidthMultiplier` (readonly real): niri doesn't say how far it scrolls a strip, so the overview fits it
- `blur` (readonly var): niri's blur as in effect, { enabled, size, passes }: the config's (`axiom compositor niri info`), its offset as the size (NiriConf.lookNodes writes the window look's size as the offset), niri's defau…
- `surfacesReady` (readonly bool): niri doesn't stack layers by axiom's order: LayerManager maps them in order itself, from the start
- `travelingTo` (readonly int): niri slides between workspaces itself
- `blockSize` (readonly int): Ids in each output's block (CompositorManager.blockSize): niri makes workspaces as they fill, so more than anyone has
- `lastLoadFailed` (readonly bool): Whether niri's last config load failed (it keeps the config before)
- `supports` (readonly var): What niri does (CompositorManager.supports).
- `builtInBinds` (readonly var): The binds niri carries out itself, by action, as axiom writes the key: Mod + drag moves a window, Mod + right drag resizes it (the Keybinds page's mouseDrag and mouseResize, which niri can't be told …

### Signals

- `layersChanged()`: Never: niri says nothing of the space layer surfaces take
- `outputsHotplugged()`: An output was connected or disconnected
- `configReloaded()`: niri loaded its config again
- `keyboardLayoutChanged()`: The keyboard layout switched
- `windowFocused(string appId)`: A window was focused; appId is its app_id
- `switcherKey(string verb, string argument)`: Never: niri's switcher binds call axiom's IPC (WindowSwitcherManager)

### Functions

- `refresh()`: Reads the outputs again (the rest comes as events)
- `activateWindow(id)`
- `closeWindow(id)`
- `placeWindow(id, workspaceId, targetId, side, restore, reinsert, floatAt)`: The overview's drop (CompositorManager.placeWindow): onto workspace `workspaceId`, beside `targetId`'s column on its `side` ("left" | "right"), into its column ("top" | "bottom", at the column's end)…
- `resizeWindow(id, dw, dh, dx, dy)`: Grows a window by (dw, dh) and, when floating, moves it by (dx, dy)
- `warpCursorToLayer(namespace, monitor, width, height, x, y)`: niri can't move the cursor (supports.cursorWarp is off)
- `toplevelFor(id)`: The Wayland toplevel for a window id, for live previews: none on niri, so the overview draws the window's icon instead
- `sendWindowToWorkspace(id)`: Sends the focused window to workspace `id`, staying put
- `scrollStrip(direction)`: Scrolls the focused output's strip a column on (1) or back (-1)
- `travel(output, legs, mode, focusId)`: A workspace switch (CompositorManager.goToWorkspace). niri slides by itself, so only the last leg counts.
- `focusOutput(name)`: Focuses output `name` (its active workspace)
- `moveWindowToOutput(name, follow)`: Moves the focused window to output `name`; focus goes along with `follow`, else stays on the output it's on
- `applyRemap(plan, outputs)`: niri's workspaces belong to their output and keep their place there (supports.outputWorkspaces): there's nothing to remap
- `leaveSwitcher()`: Nothing to let go: niri's switcher binds enter no mode (SwitcherKeys reads the keys while it's open)
- `withMainBinds(callback)`: Calls back with the binds in effect outside axiom's own (the user's, read from their config, and axiom's), or null
- `captureKeys(on)`: Nothing to do: the key recorder's window inhibits niri's shortcuts itself (KeyRecorder's ShortcutInhibitor), niri having no empty mode
- `withKeyboard(callback)`: Calls back with the keyboard's layouts ({ layouts, index, keymap }, NiriState.keyboard), or null
- `cycleKeyboardLayout(direction, callback)`: Switches to the "next" or "prev" layout, then calls back
- `withCursorPos(callback)`: niri can't say where the cursor is, nor where layer surfaces are
- `withLayerRects(callback)`
- `exitSession()`: Ends the niri session (the power menu's log out)
- `withOutputDetails(callback)`: Calls back with every output in detail, disabled ones too (NiriState.outputDetails), or null
- `applyOutputs(rules, details)`: Sets the outputs as `rules` (MonitorRule) say, now; `details` resolve a rule naming its output by description
